title: Nasal sounds, now, on time
summary: An n or m at the end of a syllable gets swallowed into the nose, so con- and com- sound alike, and maintenant (now) loses most of its letters. You also learn le train, le bus, la visite and à temps (on time).
points: é (with accent) is a clear 'ay': réserver, réparer. A plain e (re-, je, le) is softer: recommander.
n or m at the end of a syllable is swallowed into the nose: le train, trente, comparer, contempler.
Final consonants are usually silent, but not always: le bus keeps its s.
A final e means you pronounce the consonant before it: la visite (the s sounds like z).
maintenant = now. à temps = on time (related to 'temporary'. The p and s are silent).
When building a sentence, take one piece at a time. Don't jump ahead to the hard word.
drills: I want to recommend the bus.
Do you want a bit of cake?
Tu veux un peu de gâteau ?
You must confirm the visit later.
Tu dois confirmer la visite plus tard.
Can you confirm the visit now?
